intro.heading: A link-in-bio page, done carefully
intro.body: Link Yo Self gives you one page at your own username that holds everything you want to share — and tells you what people did with it.

what.heading: What it does
what.body: You add links and social accounts, choose how the page looks, and share one address. Visitors see your links; you see the clicks.
what.item1: One public page at your username, cached so it loads fast and refreshed the moment you save a change.
what.item2: Clicks per link, profile views, a day-by-day chart and the sites your visitors came from.
what.item3: A preview card generated for your page, so shared links look like something.
what.item4: An optional age warning that keeps the content out of the page until the visitor confirms.

measurement.heading: About the numbers
measurement.body: The statistics are deliberately modest, and that is the point: they are meant to be true rather than flattering.
measurement.item1: Repeat clicks from the same visitor within half a minute count once, so a double-tap does not inflate your total.
measurement.item2: Only the host name of the site a visitor came from is recorded — "instagram.com", never the full address.
measurement.item3: No visitor is identified, profiled or followed across sites. There is no advertising or analytics tracker in the product.

notYet.heading: What it is not
notYet.body: It is a focused tool, not a platform. There is no store, no scheduling, no audience messaging. If you need a page of links and honest numbers about it, it fits. If you need a marketing suite, it does not.

contact.heading: Questions
contact.body: Write to us and a person will read it.
